winner.descricao: File:San Francisco (CA, USA), Alcatraz, New Industries Building -- 2022 -- 3114.jpg New Industries Building , Alcatraz Island , San Francisco , California , USA Alcatraz, the rocky island in San Francisco Bay, transformed from a strategic military base to the most notorious maximum security prison in the United States. Originally designated as a military fort to secure the gold rush town in 1850, it later housed the army’s first military prison. Due to its isolated location and treacherous, freezing currents, the Department of Justice took over the island in 1934 and turned it into a federal prison. Here, under the strictest regime, serious criminals such as Al Capone and “Birdman” Robert Stroud were interned. The concept was simple: anyone who broke the rules ended up in Alcatraz – a place without privileges. Despite 14 escape attempts, the prison is officially considered escape-proof,
